title: How to Break Bad Habits
summary: Утсаа байн байн шалгах зэрэг муу зуршлаас хэрхэн салах тухай зөвлөгөө.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: John Russell wrote this story for VOA Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

changes: Headings, sign-off, credit line and the Words in This Story list removed.

questions.prompt: What is the main example of a bad habit in the text?
options: Eating sweet snacks while you study
Staying up too late to finish homework
questions.explain: Текст "you feel the need to check your phone" гэсэн жишээгээр эхэлж, үүнийг муу зуршил гэж нэрлэсэн.

questions.prompt: Why does Wendy Wood suggest wearing a wristwatch?
options: So you don't need your phone to check the time
So you know when to stop studying
So your family can see when you study
questions.explain: Бугуйн цаг зүүвэл "This will limit at least one reason for looking at the phone – checking the time" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: In James Clear's four steps, what is a "cue"?
options: A signal that starts a behavior
The reward you get after a behavior
A promise you make to a friend
questions.explain: "A cue is a signal. It tells your brain to do something" гэж тайлбарласан.
